question: In January 2022, V Ananth Nageswaran was appointed as the new Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) of India, thus replacing______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishnamurthy Subramanian**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In January 2022, **V Ananth Nageswaran** was appointed as the new Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) of India.
 
• He succeeded **Krishnamurthy Subramanian**, who served as the CEA from 2018 to 2021.
 
• V Ananth Nageswaran is a renowned economist, author, and professor with expertise in global economics and finance.
 
• The role of the Chief Economic Advisor includes providing key inputs for economic policies and strategies to the Government of India.
 
• The appointment of CEA is critical for shaping the Union Budget and macroeconomic frameworks of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Role of Chief Economic Advisor (CEA):**

 
 
• The CEA is the ex-officio cadre controlling authority of the Indian Economic Service.
 
• The position involves advising the government on policy formulation, economic reforms, and data analysis.
 
• The CEA plays a significant role in drafting the **Economic Survey of India**, which precedes the annual Union Budget.
 
 
 
• **Previous CEAs of India:**
 
 
• **Arvind Subramanian:** Served from 2014 to 2018; known for his work on the Goods and Services Tax (GST) and economic reforms.
 
• **Kaushik Basu:** Served from 2009 to 2012; focused on economic policy during the global financial crisis.
 
• **Krishnamurthy Subramanian:** Served from 2018 to 2021; advocated for reforms in banking and corporate governance.
 
 
 
• **Economic Survey of India:**
 
 
• The Economic Survey is an annual document prepared by the Ministry of Finance under the guidance of the CEA.
 
• It provides a detailed analysis of the Indian economy's performance in the past year and outlines future policy recommendations.
 
 
 
• **V Ananth Nageswaran's Background:**
 
 
• Prior to his appointment, he was a writer, consultant, and teacher focused on global economics and financial markets.
 
• He has authored/co-authored books on the Indian economy and contributed to various global economic forums.
